entities.name: Methyl ester reduction
observations: The encoded methyl ester COC(=O)- is converted to the corresponding hydroxymethyl group -CH2OH; the nitro group and heteroaromatic scaffold are retained.
Reaction class: selective borohydride reduction of an ester to a primary alcohol.

entities.name: Lithium borohydride
observations: Reported as the reducing reagent for the exact/core-matched transformation.

entities.name: THF and diethyl ether
observations: Tetrahydrofuran and diethyl ether are reported as solvents for the lithium borohydride ester reduction.

entities.name: Aqueous workup
observations: Routine aqueous workup is appropriate after the borohydride reduction; the retrieved record supports workup generally but does not specify detailed conditions.
